learning_outcomes.text: Analyze energy cycles performance (e.g. efficiency, power output, work and heat input) from cycle data.

syllabus_topics: Survey of thermodynamics, 1, 2 and 3 laws of thermodynamics, energy transformations
Limits of the energy flow density
Simple energy cycles, Performance criteria for steam cycle (Rankine) gas turbine (Brayton)
Steam cycle (Rankine). Detailed description with the auxiliary systems. Efficiency enhancement and refinements.
Effect of the back pressure. Feed water heating.
Steam reheating. Design and computation of the steam cycle schema.
Gas turbines. Efficiency enhancement and refinements. Pressure ratio effect. Internal heat regeneration.
Intercooling and reheating of the gas turbine. Design of the gas turbine cycle.
Heating station, joint production of heat and electricity.
Economy aspect for the district heating station
Exergy analysis of the energy cycles.
Application of the exergy analysis on the steam, gas and combined power plant
bibliography: R.W. Haywood: Analysis of Engineering Cycles. (Pergamon Press, 1991).
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
